01Stears Elections · 2023Content & storytellingThe service →

How a new election tracker beat the BBC on Google.

Stears rebuilt Nigeria’s first real-time election tracker for the 2023 general election. My job was to make sure millions of Nigerians could find it, and trust it, when results started coming in.

10,000+

programmatic candidate pages, covering every candidate for governor, senate and president. The largest digital repository of election candidate data in Nigeria at the time.

Each dot is 10 pages. Keep scrolling to light them up.

  1. 01Built the SEO strategy from scratch for searches like “2023 election results” and “presidential candidates Nigeria”.
  2. 02Designed programmatic candidate profiles: 10,000+ pages covering every candidate for governor, senate and president.
  3. 03Trained the analyst team, mostly economists, to publish for search, with a framework used across hundreds of articles.
  4. 04Coordinated editorial, engineering, data and design so pages stayed accurate and fast at peak traffic.

users, 52% from organic search

02RemotePass × Certn · 2024Launches & go-to-marketThe service →

RemotePass partners with Certn to launch employee background checks in over 190 countries

I joined RemotePass just after a $5.5M raise. Within weeks I was asked to launch its biggest partnership yet: background screening from Certn, built into the platform, to make RemotePass a safer choice for hiring around the world.

Launch visuals by the RemotePass design team. My part: the positioning, messaging, copy and launch plan.

The launch opened enterprise conversations in regulated industries like fintech and healthtech.

  2. Partner alignmentAgreed the launch narrative and timing with Certn’s global marketing team.
  3. LaunchRan the launch content: global and Middle East press releases, the announcement blog, email and social posts.
  4. SalesBuilt the enablement kit so the team could use the launch in live deals.

04RemotePass · Ask AILaunches & go-to-marketThe service →

Everyone was selling AI. We sold the answer.

Ask AI was RemotePass’s newest feature, launched at the peak of the AI craze. Every brand in our category was making the same promise. I led the campaign around a different one: how easy it is to simply ask your workforce data a question.

The insight
HR leaders, our customers and prospects, kept telling us they never had time to explore their own workforce data. Most competitors had not built a story on that.
What we made
One story from the landing page to the announcement video to the sales enablement documents, so buyers heard the same promise at every step.
My role
Led the campaign as Content Marketing Manager: the angle, the story and keeping it consistent across every channel.

Record

MQL performance after the launch. The sales team was flooded with enquiries about the product.

One story, carried across every touchpoint

01Landing pageremotepass.com/ai↗02Announcement videoWatch it on LinkedIn↗03Sales enablementDocuments for the sales team, built on the same story→

Video and visuals by the RemotePass team. My part: the angle, the story and the campaign.

06Xofu · 2026Positioning & messagingThe service →

Xofu tracks how ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Gemini cite and recommend brands. It was a new category, and buyers had no simple way to see why it mattered to them. I gave the whole story one question to answer.

“Does AI recommend us?”

  1. Rebuilt the positioning around one buyer question: “Does AI recommend us?”
  2. Rewrote the homepage, pricing, services and demo pages.
  3. Packaged pricing into four tiers: Free, Personal, Business and Agency.
  4. Launched the Citation Audit, with engagement-based onboarding emails.
